description: Source code for the Orleans streaming PubSub rendezvous grain, including classes for state storage, the grain's implementation, and logging helpers. It manages registration and unregistration of producers and consumers for stream pub/sub, state persistence, and grain lifecycle.

classes.name: PubSubGrainStateStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating state storage bridges for PubSub grains, handling dependency injection for storage providers.

classes.name: PubSubGrainState
classes.description: Data class representing the persistent state of the PubSub rendezvous grain, containing sets of producers and consumers.

classes.name: PubSubRendezvousGrain
classes.description: The main grain class implementing pub/sub rendezvous logic: registration, deregistration, validation, and notification of producers and consumers in Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Returns a state storage bridge for the specific rendezvous grain, based on stream ID parsing and storage provider lookup.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation logic, including reading persisted state.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a new producer for a specific stream, updating the persistent state.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Removes a producer from the stream, and potentially clears the state.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer for a stream, and notifies producers of the new consumer.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer and notifies producers accordingly.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Ensures that in-memory state matches persisted state, throwing if discrepancies are found.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a given stream and consumer.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Marks a subscription as faulted and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: TryClearState
methods.description: Attempts to clear stored state if no producers or consumers remain.
